Objects: The target is the second-order Taylor remainder operation for a function f and a base point/increment pair.

Domains: E,F are arbitrary real normed additive groups/normed vector spaces; f:E->F; x,v in E. Output is in F.

Quantifiers: Definition universally parameterized by E,F,their normed/vector-space structures,f,x,v.

Assumptions: No differentiability or smoothness is assumed. The Lean real Frechet derivative is a total operation, so the expression is defined even when genuine derivatives do not exist.

Conclusion: The defined value is f(x+v)-f(x)-Df(x)[v]-(1/2)*D(Df)(x)[v][v]. Subtractions occur in F; scalar 1/2 acts on F; the iterated derivative is evaluated successively on v and v.

Scopes: This is the full definition body, not an asymptotic claim or error estimate. No limit, almost-everywhere qualifier, or neighborhood restriction is part of it.

Constant dependencies: Only f,x,v and the ambient real normed structures determine the value; 1/2 is the fixed scalar coefficient.
